newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybean ends mostly down in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybean ends mostly down in slow trading.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended mostly down in slow trading on Monday with most investors maintaining a wary attitude, traders said.
The key January 1997 contract ended at an intra-day low of 3,198 yuan ($385) per tonne, losing seven yuan. It opened down at 3,200 and hit a high of 3,220.
March rose eight to 3,238, May fell 15 to 3,325, July three to 3,375, September was unchanged at 3,388 and November fell one to 3,400.
Combined volume fell to 11,000 yuan from 16,300.
